args.reason: You barely use it and the price went up.

Monthly costs {compare_billing_options.monthly_per_year_text} a year. Yearly costs {compare_billing_options.yearly_per_year_text}, so you'd save {compare_billing_options.yearly_saves_text}. Yearly is paid up front, and there's no partial refund if you cancel. You opened {get_usage.merchant} on {get_usage.days_used} of the last {get_usage.window_days} days. It's your call.
